title: DONOD: Efficient and Generalizable Instruction Fine-Tuning for LLMs via Model-Intrinsic Dataset Pruning
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a model-intrinsic dataset pruning method (DONOD) to improve the efficiency and generalization of LLM fine-tuning. The evaluations are centered on logic, mathematics, and instruction-following tasks; there is no evaluation or discussion regarding religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
